name: WE_LastPassGGH15
title: Multi-pass masked gamma-tensor GGH15 with the comparator on the last copy (regime (d)): copy offsets, offset comparator, eq-label-parameterised top, hybrid view
description: Extends Def_WE_MaskedGGH15: copyOff (layout of c witness copies with the last copy at the end), cmpMatFrom (reflected-Gray comparator reading only the levels >= o, identity before), lastPassTop (top matrix whose eq comparator rows are mask or mask' according to a flag), lastPassView (the hybrid (t, eqFlip) of the masked candidate with that comparator and top). Used to state the equality-cube flip and the fat reroute of the multi-pass candidates MP2/MP3 in regime (d).
